terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Rules for using the SENIM platform

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By using the SENIM platform, you agree to these terms. SENIM is a charity platform connecting donors, assistance seekers, and business partners in Kazakhstan.

roles.title: User Roles
roles.body: SENIM supports three roles: donor (individual or entity making a donation), assistance seeker (SUSN — socially vulnerable person requesting aid), and partner business (store accepting vouchers). The role is selected at registration and cannot be changed by the user independently.

verification.title: Recipient Verification
verification.body: Assistance seekers (SUSN) undergo verification. A document (large family certificate, disability, low-income proof) is uploaded to private storage and reviewed. AI provides a recommendation to the moderator, but the final decision is made by a human admin only. There is no automated verification — each case is reviewed manually.

payments.title: Payments and Donations
payments.body: SENIM currently operates in demo mode: no real payments are processed. Mock payments simulate a transaction without charging real money. When real payments are enabled, a separate section with the payment provider's terms will be added.

disclaimer.title: Legal Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: These terms are a draft and do not replace proper legal review. Before processing real payments and personal data at scale, a lawyer's consultation is required.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How SENIM collects, stores, and uses data

dataCollected.title: Data We Collect
dataCollected.body: SENIM collects the minimum data necessary for the platform to operate:
dataCollected.phone: Phone number — for contact and verification
dataCollected.documents: Verification documents — eGov certificates (large family, disability, low-income)
dataCollected.donations: Donation records — amount, campaign, payment status

documentStorage.title: Verification Document Storage
documentStorage.body: Verification documents are uploaded to a private Supabase Storage bucket (verification-documents). Access is restricted by RLS policies: a user can only upload and read their own documents in their own folder. Admins have access for review. Documents are not published or shared with third parties.

aiReview.title: AI-Assisted Review
aiReview.body: During document verification, AI is used to provide a recommendation to the moderator (confidence assessment, checking visible document elements). AI does not make the final decision — each document is reviewed by a human admin. AI does not have access to government databases or face-ID; it is a preliminary assessment tool, not automated verification.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.body: User data is retained for the lifetime of the account. Verification documents are stored in private storage and may be deleted after review is completed or upon user request. Donation records are retained for audit and reporting purposes.

userRights.title: User Rights
userRights.body: Users have the right to request access to their data, correction, or deletion. To do so, contact support via email. SENIM does not sell or share personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

disclaimer.title: Legal Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: This policy is a draft and does not replace proper legal review. Before processing real personal data at scale, a lawyer's consultation is required, and compliance with Kazakhstan's Personal Data Protection Law is necessary.
